problem: CAD-PARITY-011 was merged on GitHub at 2026-08-30T17:10:16Z (merge commit f593b06) while its Architect approval was recorded in the ledger with timestamps of 17:12:30Z — after the merge event. The physical git history shows the approval record (commit cc5f43a, authored 17:10:05Z) was the head of PR #99 at the moment of the merge, so the approval content physically predates the merge; the ledger's approval timestamps, however, postdate it. The record consequently violates three rules: the APPROVED → MERGED transition was recorded under the architect role (authorized roles: product-owner, implementer); its timestamp precedes the recorded approval; and no approved decision exists at or before the merge event. The historical record is immutable — rewriting the timestamps or role would falsify the audit trail — so the defect is reconciled through this Architect-owned, ACR-sanctioned overlay (Issue #100).

defects.explanation: The GitHub merge of PR #99 was performed by pectoraux, who holds product-owner authority (the repo owner; the Product Owner of record for every prior merge, e.g. ARCH-WF-001's APPROVED → MERGED under the product-owner role). The ledger recorded the event under the architect role — a role mis-recording, not an authority failure.

The recorded approval timestamps (ARCHITECT_REVIEW → APPROVED at 17:12:30Z; DEC-001 decided_at 17:12:30Z) postdate the merge event at 17:10:16Z, inverting the required ordering. The physical history contradicts the ledger's timestamps: the approval record commit cc5f43a was authored at 17:10:05Z — eleven seconds before the merge — and was the PR head that got merged, so the approval existed in the repository before the merge; the 17:12:30Z ledger values are internally inconsistent with the git events they describe.

Because DEC-001 carries decided_at 17:12:30Z, no approved decision exists at or before the merge timestamp. The decision itself is real — it rests on EV-001..EV-004 and its record commit (cc5f43a) predates the merge — but as recorded it does not precede the merge event.

evidence.description: The physical git topology: commit cc5f43a ('Governance: record Architect approval for CAD-PARITY-011', authored 2026-08-30T17:10:05Z) is the second parent of the merge commit f593b06 (2026-08-30T17:10:16Z) — the approval record was the PR #99 head at the moment of the merge, so the approval content physically predates the merge even though the ledger timestamps it at 17:12:30Z.
evidence.reproduction: git log --format='%h %cI %s' -1 cc5f43a && git rev-parse f593b06^2 && git log --format='%h %cI %s' -1 f593b06

evidence.description: The ledger defect is deterministic and attributable: at main commit 62055d2 the governance validator reports exactly three failures for CAD-PARITY-011 — transition-legality (role 'architect' not authorized on transition #8), temporal-ordering (transition #8 precedes the previous transition), and decisions (entering MERGED requires a prior recorded decision).
evidence.reproduction: git checkout 62055d2 && npm run governance -- validate
